- id: applet-piv
    status: assisted
    confidence: high
    migration_kind: package
    v1: v1 PIV APIs
    v2: Yubico.YubiKit.Piv
    evidence:
      - develop:Yubico.YubiKey/src/Yubico/YubiKey/Piv/PivSession.cs
      - yubikit:src/Piv/
    notes: Security-sensitive operations still require manual behavior review. PIV PIN, PUK, and management-key inputs remain explicit. Migrate v1 TouchNotificationCallback or the removed alpha PivSession.OnTouchRequired property to SessionCreationOptions.UserPresencePrompt; PIV touch notifications are policy-based.
    last_reviewed_commit: 2918ae0774e182a58cbc98c03c27defc5d18bc43

- id: recipe-piv-generate-key
    status: manual
    confidence: medium
    migration_kind: member
    v1: PivSession.GenerateKeyPair(...)
    v2: PivSession.AuthenticateAsync(...) followed by PivSession.GenerateKeyAsync(...)
    evidence:
      - develop:Yubico.YubiKey/examples/PivSampleCode/YubiKeyOperations/KeyPairs.cs
      - develop:Yubico.YubiKey/src/Yubico/YubiKey/Piv/PivSession.cs
      - yubikit:src/Piv/src/IPivSession.cs
      - yubikit:src/Piv/src/IYubiKeyExtensions.cs
    notes: Key generation is state-mutating and requires explicit management-key authentication and sensitive-buffer handling in v2; algorithm, slot, PIN policy, and touch policy values require manual review.
    last_reviewed_commit: 5a82db9bce05addc0385162e9f085adbc2366c5b

- id: piv-pin-only-mode
    status: assisted
    confidence: high
    migration_kind: behavior
    v1: PivSession.GetPinOnlyMode() / PivSession.SetPinOnlyMode(PivPinOnlyMode, PivAlgorithm) / PivSession.TryRecoverPinOnlyMode()
    v2: IPivSession.GetPinOnlyModeAsync(...) / IPivSession.SetPinOnlyModeAsync(...) / IPivSession.RecoverPinOnlyModeAsync(...)
    evidence:
      - develop:Yubico.YubiKey/src/Yubico/YubiKey/Piv/PivSession.Pinonly.cs
      - yubikit:src/Piv/src/IPivSession.cs
      - yubikit:src/Piv/src/Authentication/PinOnlyProtocol.cs
      - yubikit:src/Piv/src/PinOnlyMode.cs
      - yubikit:docs/plans/yubikit-gaps-remediation/ISA.md
    notes: Protected setup uses PinOnlyMode.PinProtected and disabling uses None. Authenticate first and supply the already-active key again for enabling. Recovery supports existing protected/legacy-derived configurations; new derived setup is excluded. Enable authenticates the supplied key, verifies PIN, stores PRINTED, blocks PUK and updates ADMIN. Disable restores the type-appropriate public default before deleting PRINTED then ADMIN, leaving PUK blocked. Separate commands provide no rollback; keep a secure key backup and inspect/re-authenticate after partial failure. Raw PIN/key/retry changes leave recovery objects unchanged. Reopen and recover to validate migration; see the module task guide.
    last_reviewed_commit: e042280ed7ec03a0250745ff3ff272680e5570b9

- id: piv-typed-data-objects
    status: assisted
    confidence: high
    migration_kind: type
    v1: Yubico.YubiKey.Piv.Objects.CardholderUniqueId / CardCapabilityContainer / AdminData / KeyHistory
    v2: Yubico.YubiKit.Piv.DataObjects.CardholderUniqueId / CardCapabilityContainer / AdminData / KeyHistory
    evidence:
      - yubikit:src/Piv/src/DataObjects/CardholderUniqueId.cs
      - yubikit:src/Piv/src/DataObjects/CardCapabilityContainer.cs
      - yubikit:src/Piv/src/DataObjects/AdminData.cs
      - yubikit:src/Piv/src/DataObjects/KeyHistory.cs
      - yubikit:src/Piv/src/IPivSession.cs
      - yubikit:docs/plans/yubikit-gaps-remediation/ISA.md
    notes: Typed models are readonly record structs with Encode/TryDecode and IPivSession GetCardholderUniqueIdAsync, GetCardCapabilityContainerAsync, GetAdminDataAsync, GetKeyHistoryAsync and corresponding setters. They replace the mutable v1 base-class hierarchy. CHUID/CCC accept fixed SDK provisioning shapes; raw GET/PUT supports other encodings. Constructors borrow identifier/salt memory and decoders copy it. KeyHistory counts describe retired keys and its validation is narrower than the full federal profile. ADMIN timestamps use trimmed little-endian Unix seconds, differing from Python's fixed four-byte big-endian field; coordinate cross-tool writes.
    last_reviewed_commit: e042280ed7ec03a0250745ff3ff272680e5570b9
